findings.summary: The touching-endpoint table's 'Compare' column conflicts with the overlap formula stated just above it.
findings.evidence: a and b overlap iff a.start <= b.end AND b.start <= a.end ... Meeting rooms | no overlap | <
findings.fix: Rename the column to 'Overlap test used' and note that the formula is the merge form. Rooms use a strict < on the overlap test, so touching intervals do not overlap.

findings.summary: The section does not cover an outline point (missing "complexity", "forgetting").

findings.summary: Meeting Rooms I and II use opposite comparison operators for the same touching case, which is easy to misread when skimming.
findings.evidence: Return false if intervals[i].start < intervals[i-1].end ... Pop on <= so a meeting starting as another ends reuses the room
findings.fix: Add a one-line contrast: 'I: conflict if start < prev end. II: pop if top <= start. Same rule, touching is allowed.'
